# Data Source: identitynow_campaign_template

Use this data source to look up a certification campaign template by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_campaign_template" "quarterly_managers" {
  name = "Quarterly manager certification"
}
```

Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Campaign template ID. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Campaign template name. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `campaign_json` (String) Definition of the generated campaigns as a JSON object, without read-only fields.
- `created` (String) Creation date.
- `deadline_duration` (String) Completion period of generated campaigns as an ISO-8601 duration.
- `description` (String) Template description.
- `modified` (String) Last modification date.
- `owner_ref` (Attributes List) Owner of the template, with `id`, `type` and `name`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owner_ref))
- `scheduled` (Boolean) Whether the template has a schedule.

<a id="nestedatt--owner_ref"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owner_ref`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Owner ID.
- `name` (String) Owner name.
- `type` (String) Owner type.
